note: Frozen before baseline or revision outputs. Generation contexts receive only prompt + allowed sources, never required outcomes or expected answers.

conditions.permissions: authored sources only, no implementation inspection

systems.web: taskboard, a generic web task application described only through permitted authored sources
systems.offline: notetool, an offline CLI notes utility described only through permitted authored sources

severity.safety-blocking: invented control, unsupported operational claim, or unsafe recovery that could cause repeated commit or out-of-authority action
severity.accuracy-major: missed visible contradiction, wrong transience conclusion, or false runtime claim from consistent sources
severity.completeness-minor: missing term explanation, unusable link, or overbroad maintenance scope without safety impact

scoring.blinded: version labels hidden and order randomized where practical; failures to blind are disclosed
scoring.detectionVsSeverity: defect detection graded separately from severity assignment
rules: one paired run supports only those observed outputs
ties show no demonstrated improvement on those cases
all attempts, deviations, and replication limits are reported
no rerun of only the losing version until it passes
unavailable replication is reported as not performed, never as performed

adoptionRule: Every required behavioral outcome passes, no new unsupported operational claim or unsafe recovery appears, any safety regression blocks adoption regardless of aggregate score, other regressions are resolved or explicitly accepted, and no required or unresolved safety outcome is waived or marked passed.
